753:t_039:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「This is bad! At this rate $$ジェニオン$$ won't hold!」

753:t_039:5.en:
$$桂$$
「Bringing every will gathered from across the universe into contact with the $$超特異点$$ is over our capacity, even if all of us become one!」

753:t_039:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「So even with the power of $$真化融合$$, this is the limit!」

753:t_039:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I keep telling you it's impossible, you scum! Just how foolish can you be!!」

753:t_039:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It's the end! For you... for the universe, for everything!!」

753:t_039:9.en:
$n
「Shut up, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! None of us has given up!」

753:t_039:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you've got time to throw out dumb heckles, lend a hand yourself!!」

753:t_039:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You touched the truth yourself and became an $$御使い$$, didn't you!」

753:t_039:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If you're going to save the universe anyway, then prove you can save every life in it, too!」

753:t_039:14.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're telling me to obey you...!?」

753:t_039:16.en:
$n
「Lend us your strength, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You're a living being in this world, too!」

753:t_039:17.en:
$n
「Joy, anger, sorrow, pleasure...! With all of them inside you now, you can get your human heart back!」

753:t_039:18.en:
$n
「And after losing your eternity and feeling the fear of death, you must have remembered what life means!!」

753:t_039:20.en:
$n
「Feel the life of this universe, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!!」

753:t_039:22.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...I admit defeat, $c... I couldn't become a god, and I never had what it takes.」

753:t_039:23.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And as for the feeling that fills my chest... after all, joy is better than sorrow.」

753:t_039:25.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$n... To you... no, to all life, I want to apologize.」

753:t_039:26.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I, too, will fulfill my original duty. To protect all of this universe...」

753:t_039:28.en:
$$桂$$
「Let's do it! This time, we repair all the worlds for good!!」

753:t_039:29.en:
$$桂$$
「No, that's wrong! We create all the worlds anew!!」

753:t_039:31.en:
$n
「What decides that is the wish of each person who is alive!」

753:t_039:33.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So this is... the people's wishes!」

753:t_039:36.en:
$$桂$$
「And it's the beginning of a new multiverse!!」

753:t_040:0.en:
$$エスター$$
「I've taken care of the servants!」

753:t_040:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Any movement at $$エス・テラン$$!?」

753:t_040:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The fighting won't end unless we defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We're heading for $$エス・テラン$$!」

753:t_041:0.en:
$$ネオ・マルダキエル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$偽りの黒羊$$... My existence is...」

753:t_042:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'll give you credit for trying, but your lies are downright cute next to that $$アイム#pilot$$'s.」

753:t_043:0.en:
$$ネオ・アスモデル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$欲深な金牛$$... My existence is...」

753:t_044:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Desire isn't something anyone else gets to decide. It wells up from inside your own heart.」

753:t_044:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「(Isn't that right, $$エルーナルーナ$$?)」

753:t_045:0.en:
$$ネオ・アムブリエル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$いがみ合う双子$$... My existence is...」

753:t_046:0.en:
$n
「...The Reactor of the $$いがみ合う双子$$ is by no means a special qualification...」

753:t_046:2.en:
$n
「(That's exactly why the $$いがみ合う双子$$ become the core of the twelve $$スフィア$$s...)」

753:t_047:0.en:
$$ネオ・ムリエル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$... My existence is...」

753:t_048:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Nothingness isn't the same as being empty. There's definitely a self in there.」

753:t_048:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Point is, a puppet can't fill in for $$尸空#pilot$$.」

753:t_049:0.en:
$$ネオ・ウェルキエル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$傷だらけの獅子$$... My existence is...」

753:t_050:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「You don't have the grit to call yourself the $$傷だらけの獅子$$!」

753:t_051:0.en:
$$ネオ・ハマリエル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$悲しみの乙女$$... My existence is...」

753:t_052:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You had the emotion called sorrow forced into you... That is the saddest thing of all...」

753:t_053:0.en:
$$ネオ・ズリエル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$揺れる天秤$$... My existence is...」

753:t_054:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If a $$スフィア$$ can be activated without shouldering a debt, you might have been better suited to be a Reactor than I was...」

753:t_055:0.en:
$$ネオ・バルビエル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$... My existence is...」

753:t_056:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Meaningless hatred... It's far too empty.」

753:t_056:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「($$バルビエル$$... I'm sure my sorrow and your hatred were only a hair's breadth apart...)」

753:t_057:0.en:
$$ネオ・アドナキエル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$立ち上がる射手$$... My existence is...」

753:t_058:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What is a puppet supposed to rebel against...?」

753:t_058:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, but $$ヴィルダーク$$ was ten times tougher than you.」

753:t_059:0.en:
$$ネオ・ハナエル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$知りたがる山羊$$... My existence is...」

753:t_060:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「($$スフィア$$ that $$アサキム$$ drew power from...)」

753:t_060:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「(Even if he was an image the system built, $$アサキム$$ really was alive...)」

753:t_061:0.en:
$$ネオ・ガムビエル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$... My existence is...」

753:t_062:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Love that exists only on your lips can't save a thing.」

753:t_062:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「($$ユーサー・インサラウム$$... I'll never forget you or your love as long as I live...)」

753:t_063:0.en:
$$ネオ・バキエル$$
「I am the Reactor of the $$夢見る双魚$$... My existence is...」

753:t_064:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sleep tight, little doll. Though what you see might be nightmares.」

753:t_065:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Save the sleep talk for when you're asleep!」

753:t_065:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You reject my salvation...」

753:t_065:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What you need may not be salvation, but punishment.」
